axioms.name: Experimental.P03_06.actualFiniteMomentGramExpansion
axioms.meaning: Quadratic form of the actual finite reciprocal-square moment Hankel matrix equals a finite sum of polynomial squares at its actual spectral nodes.
dependencies: Theorem 3.1 actual roots for later interpretation
axioms.supports: Upstream exact finite algebra for positive-semidefiniteness; not the target strict positivity/rank/logarithmic derivative/limit assertions.
